# E2E Tests Instructions

## Overview
End-to-end tests test full application workflows from UI to backend.

## Guidelines
- Use Playwright or Selenium for UI interactions.
- Test complete user journeys (e.g., register user, place order).
- Run against deployed app or containers.
- Include smoke tests for critical paths.

## Tools
- Playwright for browser automation.
- xUnit for test framework.

## Examples
- Login via Blazor, perform actions, verify DB changes.
